items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: I know you went to -- you were with Snub Moseley in '52 in England. ... Yeah, that's right, in '52.

ctx.x: No, this was before Snub Moseley, because I took -- I went -- then I came back, and then the European tour for USO, and after the European tour, then I think is when Snub Moseley came in.
Oh, that was -- that was during the Korean War or something.
